title: Husain Zindabad
body:
Ham Lagatey Hai'n Naara - Husain Zindabad,
Tu Hai Aaqa Hamara - Husain Zindabad.
Gham Miley Na Siwa Gham Ke Terey Duniya Me Hame'n,
Gham Manaye'n Tera Ham Aur Sada Kahtey Rahe'n,
Tera Gham Hai Hamara - Husain Zindabad,
Mangtey Hai'n Jo Bhi Milta Hai Wo Hi Dar Se Terey,
Marzi-e-rab Bhi Teri Marzi Ke Hamraah Chaley,
Tu Hai Data Hamara - Husain Zindabad,
Manga Rab Se Hai Dua'aon Me Sayyeda Ne Hame'n,
Ham Pe Lazim Hai K Ham Matam-e-shabbeer Kare'n,
Hamko Tera Sahara - Husain Zindabad,
Qaum Ye Zinda Rahey Karney Ko Matam Shah Ka,
Rakhey Mahfooz 'Raees' Isko Dua'a-e-zahra,
Milkey Bolo Khudara - Husain Zindabad.
